assertions: Original ICU78.3 handleNext state transitions, unconditional/lookahead acceptance order, dictionary-character count, status/position/end mutations and forced-progress fallback are represented over actual prepared fields. Native compiled LibreOffice word/line rules and custom lookahead/16-bit-table witnesses match 2,450 forward states. Consumed UText native-index/next32 and complete ucstrTextAccess preserve deferred 32-unit chunks, codepoint alignment, lone surrogates and explicit/NUL lengths; 1,220 native states match. Native test access changes private visibility only, without replacing headers/methods/providers. Original RuleBasedBreakIterator/RBBIDataWrapper construction, public caches/dictionaries/word/title/UNO bootstrap and native allocator/ABI remain unverified; no fake iterator factory is exported.

Original handleSafePrevious consumes the actual reverse table/trie, normalizes the source position and returns a safe restart point while retaining iterator position/status/end/dictionary fields. Native original method comparison covers 2,450 reverse states in addition to the retained 2,450 forward states. Added original utext_previous32, utext_current32, utext_getPreviousNativeIndex, utext_nativeLength and ucstrTextLength, preserving provider transitions, transient/restored cursor operations, lone surrogates and deferred length. All 1,220 native UText sequences retain earlier forward assertions and now compare full current/backward/length mutations. Public iterator/cache/dictionary/word/title/service construction and native allocator/ABI remain incomplete; a raw safe point is not exposed as a public word boundary.

Original ICU78.3 UVector32 and RBBI cache operational methods preserve source status, cursor, ring-buffer, refill and dictionary lookup order. Native comparison matches 82 vector states and 1002 logical cache/consumed-owner snapshots, using original native engines for prepared dictionary input. Concrete local engine installation, public iterator/data/provider construction and lifecycle, word/title/UNO integration, debug dumps and allocator/RTTI/thread ABI remain unverified.

Original ICU78.3 utf8_nextCharSafeBody preserves strict modes, noncharacter/surrogate rules and partial-byte consumption. Original u_strFromUTF8WithSub/u_strFromUTF8 retain the optimized counted loop, NUL loop, partial supplementary writes, full preflight, substitution policy, untouched output arguments on failure and source termination/status order. Native comparison covers 402855 complete calls, including 393216 live pair-matrix calls and 9639 retained scanner/converter/termination calls. This is the required UTF8 rule-string prerequisite; complete UnicodeString writable-buffer allocation, RBBIDataWrapper/iterator construction and word/title/service installation remain pending. No host decoder or alternate conversion policy is supplied. Unreadable native spans, overlapping storage and allocator/ABI remain unverified.

Original raw RBBIDataWrapper constructors now create actual borrowed header/table/trie/status views and owned rule strings, preserving initialization/error/version/width order, byte equality/hash, same-owner references and failed-init counter behavior. Native comparison matches 189 full initialized-field/array/reference/equality traces, including adopted/borrowed/embedded storage and 8/16/32-bit trie paths. Fresh UnicodeString::fromUTF8 uses the actual ICU converter and the existing managed UTF16 value binding; 65536 byte-pair values and 213 counted/null/long values match the original class. No public writable-buffer/alias allocator API, replacement UDataMemory owner, iterator or engine factory is supplied. Actual UDataMemory construction/loader, public iterator/engines and word/title/UNO/NatNum12 installation remain pending; native allocation/deletion/COW/thread/physical ABI and use after final release remain unverified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Borrowed typed-array struct/row views and original prepared field projections replace native pointer arithmetic; actual original rule/compiler/provider behavior is retained. No public factory replacement.
